Jello Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 12:34am

Ingredients




1 large can crushed pineapple
1 package (3 oz) lemon Jello
1 can fruit cocktail, drained
1 package (8 oz) cream cheese, softened
Cool Whip

Preparation

1 Drain crushed pineapple. Heat the juice, add Jello and stir until dissolved. Let set.  2 Whip Jello, fold in fruit cocktail and pineapple. 3  Add cream cheese to Cool Whip and fold mixture into Jello mixture. Let set.

About


A summer picnic classic.
